generation.exactPrompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Create one original gentle botanical 2D illustration for a Japanese agriculture learning app: exactly two whole chestnut nuts (kuri), uncut, with glossy chestnut-brown shells, slightly flattened rounded-angular bodies, a distinctly tapering pointed tip with a tiny dry tuft, and a broad pale tan matte basal attachment scar. Arrange the two separate nuts at different three-quarter angles so the whole outlines, pointed tips, and the broad basal scar are clearly observable. The pale scar is intact outer shell surface, NOT a cut-open interior. Avoid the uniformly round spherical appearance of horse chestnuts. Warm ivory plain background, restrained fine outlines and soft watercolor/gouache shading, gently polished highlights, minimal soft contact shadow, generous margins, matching an educational botanical crop illustration set. Square composition. No spiny burr, no leaves, no stems, no cut sections, no exposed flesh, no basket, no tools, no hands. No embedded labels, text, letters, numbers, logos or watermark. A common appearance example only, not an edibility/quality/disease assessment or an all-variety identification rule. Independent original composition, no source image input.
